## Summary

The registry holds one MA-L block for Guangzhou Juan Optical and Electronical Tech Joint Stock Co., Ltd and one for Guangzhou Juan Intelligent Tech Joint Stock Co.,Ltd, both at No. 9, Street 3, Hengling Industrial Zone, Tangdong, Tianhe District, Guangzhou [1]. US import records list Guangzhou Juan Optical at that Hengling Industrial Zone address with 75 shipments since 2007, top products printing material, VCRs and moulds, and Amazon among the consignees [2]. Guangzhou Juan Intelligent Tech appears at the same address with network, audio and camera products among its top shipments [3]; the shared address is why the second name is listed as an affiliate of this one, which is an inference from the registry, not a documented rename, so a block under it shows this entry without its country, parent or founding.

A MAC in this block is plausibly a networked camera product, inferred from the cameras and network categories among the second name's shipments [3], not from a product document, so found_in, radios and silicon are left empty. A separate Guangdong Juan Intelligent Technology company in Panyu District, which sells smart cameras under the JUANCOULD name, holds its own registry blocks and is not merged here [1][4].

No company site, FCC filing or teardown for this registrant could be consulted (the FCC ID databases refused this session's requests), and no CVE naming it was found.
